answer: Peer attestation only means something when the peers can check the work instead of the name. Reaching the lagoon of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys. The design leans on random re-execution by unrelated peers, split across independent auditors, no identity may audit its own recruit. Work waits on the terrace until a stranger signs it off, and that signature becomes the fable of the next round. Written in a plain and slightly dry register, it stays short.
